versions.changelog:
- Added explicit OpenClaw integration metadata, specifying required environment variable (UPLOAD_POST_API_KEY) and dependency on curl.
- Removed separate homepage, author, and source fields from the root metadata and moved homepage under `openclaw`.
- No changes to API, documentation, or skill behavior; purely metadata updates for deployment compatibility.
- Version number remains unchanged (1.0.0).

instagram-auto-reply-comments 1.0.1

- Added homepage and source links to the skill metadata.
- Updated metadata to include a required API key (UPLOAD_POST_API_KEY) and its description.
- Clarified and emphasized safety guidance for persistent monitors, including a warning about replying to all commenters if trigger_keywords is omitted.
- Documented the last updated date as 2026-03-29 in metadata.
- No functional API or endpoint changes.

- Initial release of the Comment-to-DM Funnel skill for Instagram via Upload-Post API.
- Enables automatic monitoring of Instagram post comments and sending DMs to commenters based on trigger keywords.
- Supports two modes: one-shot (immediate scan and DM) and persistent monitoring (continuous, automated outreach).
- Includes endpoints for monitor management, bulk or one-time scans, reading comments, sending DMs, and handling follow-up conversations.
- Designed for lead capture, DM funnels, and automating Instagram DM outreach in compliance with Meta policies.
